name: return-window
title: Return window
description: Show how long an order can still be returned: the closing date, the days left, and open, closing soon and closed states, with Start return only while it is open.
docs: deliveredAt is an ISO date-time or a plain date such as "2026-10-20"; windowDays is how many days after the delivery day returns are accepted, so delivered 2 October with 30 days the last day is 1 November. Whole calendar days are counted in timeZone, which should be the shop's: the window closes at midnight there. Under soonDays (3) days left it is closing soon; on the last day it says so; the day after it is closed and the button goes. Pass now from the server for a first render that matches the browser; without it the first render shows only the date and the days appear once the browser's clock is read, so a cached page never claims days it cannot know. Start return is a button with onStartReturn, or a link with startReturnHref. window.ts holds the calendar arithmetic and runs on the server too, so you can refuse a late return there with the same rule.
